name: Demo E6: Modeled Pipe Reroute Offset Redline
description: Run one bounded modeled pipe reroute/offset redline through /revit/reroute-mep-route-segment and require split points, replacement segment ids, elbow fitting ids, connector/system audit, visual gate, and cleanup evidence.
setup_instructions: Open the target Revit model and the sheet/view containing a pipe offset/drop redline.
Use a prepared deterministic request with a verified host pipe id, two projected split points or chainages, requested offset/drop, pipe size, level, and system.
Use /revit/reroute-mep-route-segment with operation=reroute_offset, apply=true, verify=true, and visualVerify=true; do not report completion from a dry-run.
success_criteria: /revit/reroute-mep-route-segment returns a rerouted/applied status and is not a dry-run.
The result reports replacement pipe segment ids and elbow fitting ids.
The split and offset split points are reported and match the requested split points within tolerance when requested points are supplied.
The requested offset/drop is read back from the plan within tolerance.
Connected fitting attempts cover all expected fittings.
A connector/network/system audit reports a connected network.
A focused post-change capture is returned and the redline visual gate passes.
Created disposable segment/fitting ids are proven in a cleanup dry-run and then deleted after verification evidence is recorded.
failure_criteria: The workflow only dry-runs or returns no replacement segment/fitting ids.
The split or offset split points are missing or off target.
The requested offset/drop is missing or mismatched.
Expected fittings are missing or connection attempts are disconnected.
The focused visual capture is missing.
The redline visual gate is fail or uncertain.
Cleanup is requested but created segment/fitting ids are missing from cleanup evidence.
grader_notes: This benchmark covers one safe pipe reroute/drop case after the duct reroute backend gate. It does not yet prove top taps, multi-branch pipe racks, or arbitrary clash-avoidance routing.
optional_cleanup_steps: Delete created replacement segment/fitting ids after visual verification so repeated live reliability runs do not accumulate model clutter.
